text: A rapid exit taxiway is connected to a runway at an acute angle and designed to allow landing airplanes to turn off runway at higher speeds, thereby minimizing runway occupancy time so as to increase runway efficiency. At what angle should the rapid exit taxiway be connected with the runway?
